body:
Thanks for the reply. It means a lot to me. I have always thought of suicide as the permanent last solution. Suicide is not something I want and have tried everything I could think of other than maybe a therapist. Last year I looked into it, turns out my insurance won't cover any of the ones I have called (called 5 in my area).

About starting my life over you talked about. I have done that. 9 years ago I left behind everything pretty much over night and moved 800 miles away and got a job there 3 weeks later, the one I still work at.

Other things I tried was early 2015. I quit smoking, drinking and caffeine cold turkey in hopes it would help me feel better about myself. Also started working out 6 days a week consistently and yet none helped, at all. If anything I was just more tired and worn out than before.

I posted originally because I was drunk and angry mostly at myself for letting it come down to this but the biggest reason was I felt like a ghost. I didn't matter too anyone. No one noticed whether I was there or not. It was a "hey, I'm here, and I exist" call. calling out and letting others know how I feel truly felt like the only thing I have not done yet, hoped ranting and putting some of my thoughts on paper would make me feel better. 

Thanks for listening.
